protocol.timed_scope: whole solve call; initial conversions, operator assembly, LU, advance, outputs, diagnostics
protocol.cold: clear LU cache before each sample
protocol.warm: prime identical actual-dt LU factors once; still reconstruct spatial operator
protocol.error: RMS concentration error against exact fixed-grid reference; same physical input and output work for all methods per problem
protocol.caution: small-grid method study; no claim of asymptotic or large-scale LU performance; unmet thresholds remain unmeasured, not failures

problems.diffusion: exact semidiscrete Neumann cosine, no spatial error in target
problems.transport: independent expm_multiply reference for periodic upwind+diffusion operator
